scripts.build: concurrently "npm run build --workspace=frontend" "npm run build --workspace=backend" "npm run build --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.typecheck:watch: concurrently --names "frontend,backend,dashboard" -c "green,blue,magenta" "npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck:watch" "npm --workspace=backend run typecheck:watch" "npm --workspace=dashboard run typecheck:watch"
